How to prepare for an astrology consultation

A useful consultation starts with a clear question. You might want to discuss a career change, a relationship, family concerns or the interpretation of your birth chart. Write down the main issue and the context you want to share before you connect.

Choose your astrologer and consultation mode

Compare the languages, specialities, rates and availability shown on astrologer profiles. Chat, voice and video availability can differ by astrologer. Use the mode selector above and check the current status before starting; an offline or busy astrologer may not be able to connect immediately.

Check the price before starting

Review the displayed per-minute rate and your wallet balance. The total depends on the rate and session duration. If an introductory offer is shown on your account, check its eligibility and terms before using it. Read our refund and cancellation policy for payment-related questions.

What birth details should I bring?

For a birth-chart reading, have your date of birth, birth time and birthplace ready. Tell the astrologer if the time is approximate or unknown, rather than presenting a guess as exact. Some discussions, such as a general tarot question, may use a different approach; ask the astrologer what they need.

Can I choose a specialist for my question?

Use the profile specialities to find a suitable approach. Explore kundli readings, career astrology, marriage matching or tarot readings to understand the different services before choosing.

What should I expect from the session?

Ask the astrologer to explain the interpretation and any assumptions they make. A reading is guidance, not a promise of a particular outcome. Keep your own circumstances and choices central to decisions. You can review our safety guidelines before sharing personal information.

How do I get help with a session or payment?

Email support@astrowani.com with the relevant session or payment reference. Do not share passwords or payment PINs. Our privacy policy explains how personal information is handled.
